source: https://www.matmanners.com/shapes (Squarespace shape pages — excludes ding repair, second-hand stock, and custom order deposits)

brands.name: Mat Manners Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped performance and big-wave surfboards by Mat Manners in Margaret River, Western Australia — shortboards, grovelers, step-ups, and rhino chasers from the workshop on Auger Way West.

models.name: Best Mate
models.description: A super hi-performance all-round shortboard for all types of waves — your Best Mate. Sizes: 4'10–7'0". Fin setup: 3-fin FCS II / Futures. Best for: 2–6 ft waves.

models.name: Keeper
models.description: Hi-performance small-wave board with more volume and shorter than your all-rounder. Sizes: 4'10–7'0". Fin setup: 3/5-fin FCS II / Futures. Best for: smaller waves.

models.name: Droid
models.description: Super quick board that drives hard and holds its lines. Sizes: 4'10–7'0". Fin setup: 3/5-fin FCS II / Futures. Best for: small to medium surf.

models.name: River
models.description: The River is fast and smooth down the line — the flow-rider. Such a fun, easy board to ride. Sizes: 4'10–7'0". Fin setup: 2/3/5-fin FCS II / Futures. Best for: small waves.

models.name: Rondog
models.description: Big-wave boards tested in the heaviest waves Australia has to offer — tried and proven over the last 30 years by the best big-wave surfers around. Sizes: 7'0"–10'6". Fin setup: 3/5-fin FCS II / Futures.

models.name: Selamt Datang
models.description: Step-up board proven across Australia, Indonesia, and the world. Sizes: 3" or more longer than your standard shortboard. Fin setup: 3/5-fin FCS II / Futures. Best for: 4–6 ft waves.

models.name: Magic Carpet
models.description: This board will motivate you and get your stoke back when the swell drops — very loose and fun to ride. PU or EPS available. Sizes: 4'10–6'6". Fin setup: 3/5-fin FCS II / Futures. Best for: tiny to small waves.

models.name: Orc
models.description: The Orc is the answer for bigger surfers wanting a board they can shred on — volume and curves in all the right places. Sizes: 6'6"–7'6". Fin setup: 3/5-fin FCS II / Futures. Best for: all-round conditions.
